newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to discuss durum wheat aid changes.
newsitem.headline: EU to discuss durum wheat aid changes.

text.p: European Union farm ministers will discuss a proposal to change an aid scheme for durum wheat producers on Monday, at Italy's request, EU officials said.
The Commission proposed in July fixing a maximum guaranteed area for each member state that would be shared between traditional producers.
It also proposed the compulsory use of certified seed and anti-fraud measures to ensure that output remained in line with the planted area.
In September ministers from traditional producer countries, notably Italy, demanded bigger areas while others such as Germany and Austria sought to be included in the scheme.
Officials said a decision was only possible in December after the European Parliament has given an opinion. --Peter Blackburn, Brussels Bureau +322 287 6830
